mapper.insert: insert into `accounts` (id, user_id, account_number, account_password, balance, is_active, account_type, created_at, last_update) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountPassword}, #{balance}, #{isActive}, #{accountType}, #{createdAt}, #{lastUpdate});
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET balance = #{balance}, last_update = NOW() -- 현재 시간으로 업데이트 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: select acc.* from `accounts` acc join `users` u on acc.user_id = u.id where u.email = #{email};
select * from `accounts` acc join `users` usr on acc.user_id = usr.id where account_number = #{accountNumber} and email = #{email};
